review.notes: Full structural scan (all code fences balanced; the two ``` blocks are the printed benchmark code listings of Section 4.3.1) plus an automated normalized 4-gram containment diff of every one of the 92 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown; every low-containment page was then inspected line-by-line (chart-axis labels and row-major table reordering explain most residuals; Tables 1-15, 20, 26, 27, 29, 33, 34 bodies are present). Systematic finding: all footnote bodies except footnote 1 were dropped by OCR while their markers survive - bodies 2-13 and 15-22 restored from the PDF text layer (fn2, fn9 tail, fn18 tail verified on renders). Table 2 header names, caption key symbols, in-table result symbols and the Llama Guard 14 superscript verified on 300/600/120-dpi renders. Table 20 placement restored to the printed order. Coverage is partial: prose of pages not flagged by the diff was machine-scanned only, not read line-by-line, and reference entries were checked by containment only.

patches.before: $^{5}$ connected by a three-layer Clos network (Lee et al., 2024). At the bottom layer, each rack hosts 16 GPUs split between two servers and connected by a single Minipack2 top-of-the-rack (ToR) switch. In the middle layer, 192 such racks are connected by Cluster Switches to form a pod of 3,072 GPUs with full bisection bandwidth, ensuring no oversubscription. At the top layer, eight such pods within the same datacenter building are connected via Aggregation Switches to form a cluster of 24K GPUs. However, network connectivity at the aggregation layer does not maintain full bisection bandwidth and instead has an oversubscription ratio of 1:7. Our model parallelism methods (see Section 3.3.2) and training job scheduler (Choudhury et al., 2024) are all optimized to be aware of network topology, aiming to minimize network communication across pods.
patches.after:

However, network connectivity at the aggregation layer does not maintain full bisection bandwidth and instead has an oversubscription ratio of 1:7.
